name: grindstone
description: Keeps Claude working until you stop it: give it a task, or none and it finds valuable work itself (fixes, health work, planned features). Structured notes, value-based prioritisation, rotating reviews, auto-resume after usage limits, and a guard that keeps it inside the project folder.

retry_minutes.title: Retry interval after a usage limit (minutes)
retry_minutes.description: While usage-limited, Grindstone retries this often until your limit resets. Failed retries don't use quota.

review_every.title: Review every N cycles
review_every.description: Every Nth cycle, Claude steps back and reviews the whole project through a rotating lens instead of taking the next task.

allow_remote.title: Allow pushing and publishing
allow_remote.description: Let Grindstone run git push, open PRs and publish. Off by default: commits stay on your machine.

extra_allowed_paths.title: Extra folders it may change
extra_allowed_paths.description: Comma-separated folders Grindstone may change besides the project folder, e.g. ~/code/shared-lib. Leave empty to keep it inside the project.
